mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail under a third quarter moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 48 degrees, with no rain in the forecast.

The city has two important updates. First, winter street parking rules begin on November 20, requiring alternate side parking between 1 AM and 6 AM. Second, the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do in our area today, including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on November 2 or test your knowledge at various trivia nights starting November 4.

In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after he was found asleep behind the wheel.
Today's flavor of the day at the Verona Culver's is Mint Explosion. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
